avis.texte: This product is AMAZING!!! At first I was very skeptical, but it works so well to my surprise. I only use this on my face 3 days out of each week since it can get very aggressive when Peeling. The reason I’m using this product is because I bought “faded topicals” to fade my stubborn hyperpigmentation and dark spots due to facial growth and acne (I have PCOS). However, the faded topicals cream made my hyperpigmentation/dark spots turn 2 shades darker and change in texture of my skin. I was disappointed and desperate. When I came across this product it was a game changer! So every week I alternate. For 3 days I use the oil overnight and the next week I’ll use it for 3 days and rinse off after 15 mins. By day 6 is when I noticed the peeling. Unfortunately, I wear makeup to cover up my hyperpigmentation, so I ended up using a razor to remove the dead skin that’s peeling off and my face feels super smooth and I have no damage to my skin. Within a week of use I see a huge difference in my skin. My skin is smooth, bright, and very plump. The ONLY downside is this product burns for 15-20 mins but then goes away. But overall, it works pretty well :) Btw the pictures you see are before and after of just one week using the product! I already see a huge improvement.

I’ve been using the YAFUSIPE Yellow Peeling Oil for a little while now, and overall it’s just an okay product—there are some good things about it, but it’s not perfect. The biggest thing I noticed is that it does exfoliate pretty well. After a few days of consistent use, you can start to see some peeling, especially on areas like elbows, knees, or darker spots. It definitely feels like it’s working to remove dead skin and smooth things out over time. I also like that it can be used on different parts of the body, and the application process is pretty simple—just apply a thin layer and let it do its thing. The formula includes ingredients like salicylic acid and plant extracts, which are meant to help with exfoliation and skin texture. That said, it’s not a miracle product. The results aren’t super fast or dramatic, especially if you’re expecting major lightening or even skin tone quickly. It takes consistency, and even then the improvement is more gradual. Another thing to keep in mind is that it’s pretty strong. If you have sensitive skin, it might feel a bit intense or cause irritation if you’re not careful, so doing a patch test first is definitely a good idea. Overall, it’s a decent exfoliating treatment if you’re patient and use it correctly. It can help improve texture and gradually brighten certain areas, but it’s not a quick fix and may not work the same for everyone.

I recently tried the peeling oil and unfortunately, my experience has been quite disappointing. From the very beginning, I followed all the instructions carefully, but the product turned out to be more water-based than anything else. After a week of use, I noticed no results, and even after two weeks, my skin had not improved at all. Instead of the promised benefits, I ended up with damage to my skin, which you can see in the images I’ve attached. The product did nothing to help with the dark marks I was hoping to reduce, and areas of my skin that I didn't even apply the oil to are still problematic. It's frustrating to see other customers satisfied with a product that did not work for me. I can only wonder if I received a defective version, as my experience was far from what was advertised. On a positive note, I did manage to return the product and received my refund, which is a relief. However, I can't recommend this peeling oil based on my experience.

avis.titre: Looks like it working so far
avis.texte: I recently started using this. The instructions was confusing so I did my own thing. I just applied once at night on my arms and leg after I showered. I gave myself enough time before going to bed so the oil didn't get on my sheets. I applied the oil like I would with lotion on my arms and leg. Depending on the night, if I was still up 15-20 mins after first application, I'll do a quick second application. If I was tired, I would just go to bed, not rinsing it off. Starting day 4 or 5, I started noticing flakes where I applied the oil. Day 7+ I saw more peeling. It's not one big pull like you see in the pictures. It's here and there but definitely peeling. One day I woke up and saw more peeling spots. The new area is slightly lighter in tone so that to let me know which area hasn't peeled yet. So far, so good. Just wished everything peeled at once.
